_note: #159 claims corpus: every DATED, PRICED entry/bottom band attributed to
Danny anywhere in PRD §5k/§5l/§5m/§5n/§5o/§5p, transcribed verbatim so
the owner can check each row against the source. Sibling artifact to the
danny_vh_claims.json #142 proposes; that one asks whether our DETECTOR
finds his hole, this one asks when our TIERS reached his band.
`timing` is the load-bearing field and it is not a detail:
contemporaneous = the band was published while price was still in it
retrospective   = the band was named after price had left it
EVERY row in this corpus is retrospective. That is a finding, not an
oversight (see BACKTEST_RESULTS §51.1) — no contemporaneous dated+priced
entry claim exists anywhere in the repo's five sweeps of his posts.
`scored` rows carry a band and a publication date and enter the
statistics. Unscored rows are retrospective anecdotes with no usable
date (his 2023 campaigns, reached only through 2026 retellings); they
are recorded so a later session does not mistake them for new material.
#177 (2026-11-09): rows with forward:true are the FORWARD ledger —
timing is DERIVED by add_claim (contemporaneous iff captured within
CAPTURE_DAYS of published) and they are scored only by forward_read(),
never by §51's replay. The three §5r rows are retrospective (captured
7+ days late) and are recorded, not scored.
